diagnostics.message: google_alloydb_user.users is provisioned on google_alloydb_cluster.primary without any ordering guarantee relative to google_alloydb_instance.primary. Per the provider documentation, database users should only be created after the primary instance exists (the official examples attach depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.default] to google_alloydb_user), since user provisioning requires the instance backing the cluster to be in place. Add a bare `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.primary]` to google_alloydb_user.users.
